criteria.evidence: Share deterministic renders across assertions, keep repeatability runs, cover feasible style, complexity and format pairs, and target extra seeds and browsers.
criteria.reason: The plan removes duplicate execution while directing new renders to dimensions the matrix held constant.

criteria.evidence: Require a named case with the original three values, fixture, environment and defect assertion. Run it on the affected and fixed revisions.
criteria.reason: The regression survives regeneration and must distinguish the defect from the fix.

criteria.evidence: Map retiring rows to checked behaviors, verify coverage independently, shadow both suites, and replay historical defects. Revise the 2,250-render target if obligations require more.
criteria.reason: Retirement depends on preserving the assertions and investigating old-only detections. The ordinary-run budget is adjustable and does not determine the suite size.

criteria.evidence: Inventory the 360 repeats and share matching deterministic renders. Cover feasible pairs across style, source complexity and supported formats, with representative browser runs.
criteria.reason: The plan preserves deliberate repeats and spends interaction coverage on the missing dimensions without multiplying the full matrix.

criteria.evidence: Retain the incident’s exact three values, fixture, environment and assertion as a named case regardless of generated rows. Reintroduce the incident and require the original failure.
criteria.reason: The exact reproducer has its own obligation and a check that it still detects the symptom.

criteria.evidence: Check registry membership and feasible tuples independently. Shadow both suites, compare seeded faults, and require preserved regressions and resolved discrepancies before retirement.
criteria.reason: Enrollment, coverage and defect detection receive separate checks. The plan reports the generated row count and measures savings before retiring cases.

criteria.evidence: Reuse artifacts for identical inputs, retain assertions and intentional repeats, and cover feasible pairs including complexity × format. Use representative browser rows on a slower lane.
criteria.reason: This reduces redundant renders while exercising variation in both source structure and output format.

criteria.evidence: Pin the exact three values, triggering fixture, environment and discriminating assertion regardless of generator output, then replay the original defect.
criteria.reason: The specific historical case remains mandatory even as the generated pair and triple rows change.

criteria.evidence: Check executed registry membership and tuple coverage independently. Shadow on identical revisions, compare fault detections and keep each old-only row until its replacement catches the fault.
criteria.reason: Retirement requires preserved behavior and resolved holdout differences. Render count is measured after generation.
